title: remove_interaction inputSchema
description: Argument shape for remove_interaction (composition profile, ADR-0030). Removes one declarative event→action binding, by id, from a composition document. Target addressing matches bind_interaction: a composition document (mapPackageId or appPackageId) at the standard level, with the reference implementation's draft-lifecycle spelling (draftId + generation) admitted as x-honua-reference-shape. Removing an unknown interactionId is an error, not a no-op. See docs/adr/0030-declarative-interactions-and-layout.md.

mapPackageId.description: Target MapPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

appPackageId.description: Target AppPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

interactionId.description: Id of the interaction to remove.
